_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

teacher_use_pct.basis: share of Texas school and district leaders who reported teachers using AI, fall 2025, per Texas 2036

student_policy_pct.basis: share who reported a district policy governing student AI use

staff_policy_pct.basis: share who reported a policy for teachers and staff

states_with_guidance.basis: states with some form of statewide AI guidance for schools, Texas 2036's count; Texas is not among them (c6)

voter_privacy_pct.basis: nearly this share of Texas voters, approximate, never exact

voter_literacy_pct.basis: share of Texas voters who say teaching responsible AI use is important

survey_year.basis: the survey was taken in the fall of this year

priorities.basis: the four priorities the report names

per_hundred.basis: DRAWING UNIT: one desk, seat or chip per leader in a hundred

teacher_use_of_100.basis: units lit for teacher use at the drawing unit

student_use_of_100.basis: units lit for student use at the drawing unit

student_policy_of_100.basis: units carrying a written student policy at the drawing unit

staff_policy_of_100.basis: units carrying a written staff policy at the drawing unit
